race.comment: WINTERY (4) resumes as the horse to beat on best form, with her last campaign built around stronger Caulfield Open form assignments and a Colac trial win two weeks ago suggesting she is ready to return well. Watch the betting but she's got the ability. SKJALDMO (9) is the obvious danger after winning as an odds-on favourite at this track with Billy Egan keeping the ride. Has upside and can go on with it. NORDIC STRIKE (3) has been costly as favourite at his past two but is racing well and sets up nicely from the soft gate. Can give a sight. MYSTIC REIGN (1) resumes for a new yard with a 3kg claim and higher-grade form around Flemington and Sandown-Hillside, watch the market. GUNZ (2) resumes with each way claims.
